hook: A kid at a robot carnival in China took a humanoid robot *by the hand* and walked off with it
caption:
At a robot carnival in Shenzhen, China, a young boy grabbed a humanoid robot's hand and led it away. The robot simply followed him.
The owner stepped in soon after and used a handle on the robot's back to bring it back.
The carnival showed more than 500 robots from over 100 companies during the APEC week in Shenzhen.
